html: GeoG2U-Bench: When Does Generation Help Understanding in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing? has been accepted to NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight. FreeSpec: Training-Free Long Video Generation via Singular-Spectrum Reconstruction has also been accepted to NeurIPS 2026.

Two papers are forthcoming in Neural Networks: HiFiVe: High-Fidelity Vehicle Generation Leveraging Auto-Regressive 2D Generative Priors and Revealing and Overcoming Fairness Confusion in Out-of-Distribution Detection.
Our transformer tracking paper Enhanced Semantic Alignment in Transformer Tracking via Position Learning and Force-Directed Attention is forthcoming in TPAMI.
Three new works on edge-native generation and 3D vehicle generation are available: JuZhou 1.0, 3DCarGen, and MM-TRELLIS.
Three papers appeared at ICASSP 2026: Deconfusion CLIP, DepthShield, and Boosting Knowledge Distillation via Local Categories Similarity Scaling.
A new preprint on efficient ultra-high-resolution remote-sensing understanding is available: Semantic-Geometric Dual Compression.
A new preprint on agent-based active perception is available: GeoEyes.
On the Two Facets to Conquer Wild Out-of-Distribution Detection has been accepted by TPAMI.
C-WOE: Clustering for Out-of-Distribution Detection Learning With Wild Outlier Exposure has been accepted by TIP.
Continuous Review and Timely Correction: Enhancing the Resistance to Noisy Labels via Self-Not-True and Class-Wise Distillation has been accepted by TPAMI.
Temporal-Enhanced Multimodal Transformer for Referring Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation has been accepted by TCSVT.
Our work with Li Hao has been accepted by TCSVT.
Our work with Songyuan has been accepted by TPAMI.
Harnessing Massive Satellite Imagery with Efficient Masked Image Modeling has been accepted by ICCV 2025.
Our work with Keliang has been accepted by TPAMI.
